specificationRepositoryChecked.note: VCF Automation is not among the products specified in vmware/vcf-api-specs. No OpenAPI or Swagger document is published for the operations used here, and the Broadcom xAPIs pages that document them offer no machine-readable download. docs/contract.json is therefore derived from rendered reference documentation, not from a specification.

gapsInTheDocumentation: The access-token page documents only the 200 OK response. No failure status code is published for that operation.
The access-token payload is published as a literal string; there is no required/optional table for grant_type or refresh_token.
The deployment pages render 401, 403, 404 and 409 with the same schema as the 200 response, so no error envelope is documented.
No Accept version header (for example application/json;version=9.1.0) and no apiVersion query parameter appear on any page fetched for these operations.
No page fetched offers an OpenAPI or Swagger download.
